description.value: Hyatt Place Prince George is a branded mid-scale hotel situated in downtown Prince George, a major waypoint city for cyclists travelling the interior of British Columbia. As part of the global Hyatt Place chain, it offers a consistent, full-service lodging experience in a city that anchors connections between several long-distance touring routes. Touring cyclists passing through Prince George will find it a convenient urban base with access to city services.
